subject: prd/plan-new
statement: When validating a plan/v2 plan before checkpoint presentation or freeze, the plan gate shall validate the closed assessment and non-empty resolvable citation set, mechanically recompute the execution profile under the recorded policy version, and reject any missing/unknown value, absent/unresolved citation set, derived-profile mismatch, downward assurance change, or harness, vendor-product, native-model, native-effort, or provider-specific context identifier.
rationale: deterministic validation enforces structure, citation resolution, derivation, and portability; EVAL-2 plus the checkpoint judge substantive support
fit_criterion: missing/unknown, absent/unresolved citation, tamper, assurance-lowering, harness, vendor-product, native-model, native-effort, and provider-context fixtures fail before checkpoint/freeze with exact defects; valid demand is byte-identical across repeats; EVAL-2/checkpoint reject irrelevant, contradictory, or partial support
